newsitem.title: USA: Cowboys' Irvin denies sex assault allegations.
newsitem.headline: Cowboys' Irvin denies sex assault allegations.

text.p: Dallas Cowboys star wide receiver Michael Irvin on Tuesday flatly denied allegations that he sexually assaulted a 23-year-old woman.
"I have not done anything. I don't even know what anybody is talking about," Irvin told reporters at the Cowboys' training facility near Dallas.

Dallas police earlier on Tuesday said Irvin, 30, and Cowboys' teammate Erik Williams were under investigation for allegedly sexually assaulting a woman who said she was raped at gunpoint at Williams' home.
Police said the 23-year-old woman told them that Irvin placed a gun against her head while Williams and the other man raped her.
But Irvin, who is on probation after pleading no contest to felony cocaine possession charges early this year, said the allegations were false.
"I haven't done anything in any way, shape or form to violate my probation," said Irvin.
